name: naswood-os-dev
install:
pnpm install
curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash /dev/stdin --channel 8.0
export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH"
start:
sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || true
export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH:$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$(ls $HOME/.nvm/versions/node | tail -1)/bin"
cd /workspace && (test -f package.json || cd /tmp/naswood-web) && ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://0.0.0.0:5080 dotnet run --project src/Hosts/Naswood.Api/Naswood.Api.csproj --no-launch-profile &
pnpm --filter @naswood/web dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
